saints.name: Peter Damian
saints.legacy: Reformer and defender of Church integrity
saints.summary: Peter Damian was a prominent 11th-century cardinal and bishop known for his reformative efforts within the Church. He dedicated his life to combating simony and ecclesiastical corruption, serving as an advisor to seven popes. His commitment to prayer and asceticism, along with his leadership, left a lasting impact on the Church's moral and spiritual direction.

saints.name: Serenus
saints.summary: Saint Serenus was a Greek martyr who lived during the early 4th century. He dedicated his life to God through celibacy, penance, and prayer, cultivating a garden in Sirmium, Pannonia. After being falsely accused of impropriety, he boldly professed his Christian faith and was beheaded for his refusal to sacrifice to the gods.
